title: Credit Standard: Ceiling on a Tenant's Total Prepaid Rent across Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plans
content:
**Standard.** Across all of a tenant's agreements, the unused prepaid credit on the tenant's active Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plans, plus the new prepayment, may not exceed $15000.00; a larger purchase is referred to the district office. Each plan's own prepayment may not exceed that plan's largest accepted prepayment for one plan.

## Terms used

- **Unused prepaid credit on active plans** is the total, on the day the purchase is handled, of the prepaid credit not yet applied on every plan of the tenant that is in active status, whichever agreement each plan covers. Prepaid credit rises when a prepayment is received and falls with each monthly application, each refund and any forfeiture application. A plan in any other status (pending payment, completed, ended early, forfeited or cancelled) adds nothing to this total.
- **The new prepayment** is the prepayment of the plan being bought.
- **The ceiling** is $15000.00 for the tenant as a whole. The sum may equal $15000.00; only an amount above it is over the ceiling.
- **The per-plan limit** is the largest prepayment the plan being bought accepts for one plan, as set for each plan.

## Two tests, both applied

| Test | Compared amount | Limit | Outcome when exceeded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tenant ceiling | Unused prepaid credit on all active plans of the tenant, plus the new prepayment | $15000.00 | The purchase is referred to the district office |
| Per-plan limit | The new prepayment alone | The plan's largest accepted prepayment for one plan | The prepayment exceeds what the plan accepts |

## Worked examples (hypothetical tenants and amounts)

1. A tenant has two active plans with unused credit of $6,100.00 and $3,100.00, a total of $9,200.00. A new prepayment of $5,800.00 brings the sum to exactly $15000.00, which does not exceed the ceiling.
2. The same tenant with a new prepayment of $5,800.01 reaches $15000.01, which exceeds the ceiling; the purchase is referred to the district office.
3. A tenant whose only other plan is completed has no unused credit on active plans; a new prepayment is compared with the ceiling on its own, and must also be within the per-plan limit of the plan being bought.
